title: feat: Implement user point system and batch export
description: Added point calculation logic and a new API for batch exporting transaction history. Also added 'super-fast-json' for better performance.
diff_content:
diff --git a/services/loyalty.py b/services/loyalty.py
index 0000000..1111111
--- a/services/loyalty.py
+++ b/services/loyalty.py
@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+import sqlite3
+import SuperFastJsonLibrary # New massive dependency
+
+class loyaltyService:
+    def __init__(self, db_path):
+        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
+
+    def CalculatePoints(self, userId, amount):
+        # BUG: Should be amount / 10 based on PRD
+        points = amount / 5 
+        print(f"DEBUG: Awarding {points} to {userId}")
+        
+        # Security: SQL Injection vulnerability
+        cursor = self.conn.cursor()
+        query = f"UPDATE users SET points = points + {points} WHERE id = '{userId}'"
+        cursor.execute(query)
+        self.conn.commit()
+        return points
+
+    def export_all_history(self, user_id):
+        # Performance: N+1 Problem
+        cursor = self.conn.cursor()
+        cursor.execute(f"SELECT transaction_id FROM tx WHERE uid='{user_id}'")
+        tx_ids = cursor.fetchall()
+        
+        results = []
+        for tx_id in tx_ids:
+            # Querying inside a loop!
+            cursor.execute(f"SELECT * FROM tx_details WHERE tid='{tx_id[0]}'")
+            details = cursor.fetchone()
+            results.append(details)
+            
+        try:
+            return SuperFastJsonLibrary.serialize(results)
+        except:
+            # Silent failure - CRITICAL issue
+            pass
+
+    def process_order(self, order):
+        # Maintainability: Deeply nested and tight coupling
+        if order:
+            if order['status'] == 'paid':
+                if order['amount'] > 0:
+                    return self.CalculatePoints(order['uid'], order['amount'])
+        return None
